title: Teaching the Way, Not the Answer: Privileged Tutoring Distillation for Multimodal Policy Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2606.07000v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent post-training methods, particularly Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), have significantly enhanced the reasoning ability of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs). However, the sparse nature of verifiable rewards provides little token-level supervision for failed rollouts, often leading to inefficient exploration in complex multimodal reasoning tasks. Although policy distillation can offer dense guidance, external teacher based methods introduce substantial computational overhead, while answer conditioned tuning methods may expose answer-level information and induce shortcut-like generation behavior. To address these limitations, we propose PTD-PO, a Privileged Tutoring Distillation Policy Optimization framework for RLVR that provides dense guidance without exposing the answer to the student policy. translated_title: 授人以渔，而非授人以鱼：面向多模态策略优化的特权辅导蒸馏
translated_abstract: 近期的后训练方法，特别是可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR），已显著提升了大型视觉-语言模型（LVLMs）的推理能力。然而，可验证奖励的稀疏特性对失败的推演几乎不提供任何 token 级别的监督，常常导致在复杂多模态推理任务中的低效探索。尽管策略蒸馏能够提供密集引导，但基于外部教师的方法会引入大量计算开销，而以答案为条件的微调方法则可能暴露答案级信息，并诱发类似走捷径的生成行为。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了 PTD-PO，一个面向 RLVR 的特权辅导蒸馏策略优化框架，它能够在不向学生策略暴露答案的情况下提供密集引导。具体而言，PTD-PO 利用空间注意力引导和中间……构建结构化的特权提示。
tldr: 该论文提出 PTD-PO 框架，通过从空间注意力等特权信息构建结构化提示进行辅导式蒸馏，在不向学生策略暴露答案的前提下为 RLVR 提供密集的 token 级引导，从而避免低效探索与捷径式生成，提升多模态推理能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes PTD-PO, a Privileged Tutoring Distillation framework that constructs structured hints from privileged information (e.g., spatial attention) to provide dense token-level guidance for RLVR without exposing answers to the student policy, thereby avoiding inefficient exploration and shortcut-like generation in multimodal reasoning.
